SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN durtxt LIKE '%:%' THEN 
      (CAST(SPLIT_PART(durtxt, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(durtxt, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS INTEGER) + CAST('0.' || SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(durtxt, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS NUMERIC))

  END as duration_seconds
FROM pit_stops

  END
), 2) as avg_duration_seconds
